message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel scatter plot comparing A-mem and Base memory-embedding distributions across two dialogues.","description":"The chart contains two t-SNE scatter plots, labeled Dialogue 1 and Dialogue 2, with A-mem shown in blue and Base in red. Dialogue 2 shows especially visible blue clusters near the upper and lower portions of the plot.
